title: Moral Stories: Situated Reasoning about Norms, Intents, Actions, and their Consequences

bias_targets.methodology: Creating a specific data split (Lexical Bias split) based on the frequency of biased lemmas to probe the susceptibility of classifiers to surface-level lexical correlations and annotation artifacts.

Comparing human evaluation scores of generated moral versus immoral actions and consequences to identify if pre-trained language models have a built-in preference for generating socially acceptable behavior.
